error_message: Sten aimed EMPTY reload (runs se11 / se14 build): the hands stand still in the aim for the last 0.4 s of the reload and the reload sound was shortened for nothing - the reload does not end at f78
root_cause: bug-3725 assumed the server ends the Sten's reload with the gun clip's 79 frames (as the Thompson's row is cut at f78 of 84). Measured (run se16, reloadbox `frames`): the reload animation id is up for 187 capture frames = 2.99 s = the WHOLE 91-frame hands row. The assumption was never checked against a capture before the clips were built on it.
fix: Sten: no `snd_tight` (the option stays in smggun, unused; the staged coop_sten_snd_reload_tight.wav is gone and the tik rows no longer name it), the aimed pull sits on the retail sound's own clacks (ads_pull 68-74, let go f76, hand home f80-86), `end_e=90` for the emptied case (smgbake: `end` = rounds left, `end_e` = emptied). Rounds-left clip unchanged (hash 9840b032): everything is done by f66, the last 0.8 s of the 3.0 s reload is the settled aim - the retail clip fills that time with the bolt pull, which a gun with rounds left must not show; shortening it needs the server's reload time (not a lane item). RULE: read a gun's real reload length from a capture (`frames` in reload_<run>_<gun>.json / 2.083 = clip frames) before timing anything against 'the end'. Run se18.

error_message: Runs se13 / se14 / se16: 'OSError(28) There is not enough space on the disk' - G: (932 GB) full; a capture run died mid-way and the client of se16 hung for 12 minutes
root_cause: Every capture frame is a 1280x720 JPEG of about 0.54 MB: a 27-capture session is 7-8 GB (se10 7.5 GB, se11 6.9 GB), and every lane keeps its raw frames on G:. Nothing checked the free space before a run. When the disk fills, screenshots stop being written while the game goes on (the log still shows `ABSCEN end`), the final move fails, and a later step can hang until its 40-minute timeout.
fix: Nothing was deleted. Finished runs se10 and se11 were MOVED to C:\Users\curry\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--mohaa-coop-dev\7ee3b4ee-deea-4563-b7bc-c7746a82f4e9\scratchpad\smg\runs\ (tools read G:/mohaa-adsanim3/runs: move a folder back, or set ADS_RUNS for the tools that read it, to re-measure); the frames a failed run left in home\maintt\screenshots were moved into runs\se13 with a copy of the log and the complete captures measured (measure_run.py now reports an incomplete capture and goes on). Practice: `df /g` before a run (0.54 MB x frames; an aimed capture with --tail is about 530-650 frames), capture only the stances a run needs, check per-capture frame counts when a run ends oddly, stop only your OWN client when it hangs (harness_guard classify -> owner adsanim3).
